gallery.title: File:Woolwich, public art collage.jpg
gallery.description: Collage of six photographs (all by Kleon3) of public art in Woolwich, SE London, UK. From left to right, top to bottom: 1) Crimean War Memorial at the Royal Artillery Barracks' parade ground; 2) Lioness resting pawn on urn, or Tom Cribbs memorial, Saint Mary's Gardens; 3) Statue of Nike, goddess of victory, by Pavlos Angelos Kougioumtzis, at the Main Guardhouse, Royal Arsenal; 4) Second Boer War Memorial, near St George's Garrison Church, Grand Depot Road; 5) Street Life, by Michael Craig-Martin in Woolwich Arsenal DLR Station; 6) World War I Memorial, Cadogan Road, Royal Arsenal.

gallery.title: File:Woolwich Arsenal Station.png
gallery.description: Woolwich Arsenal station, National Rail entrance This station opened in 1849, serving the North Kent Line from London to Gillingham. The station building was rebuilt in 1906 with a London brick-built structure, very typical of southeast London. The current station building dates from 1996, and has a modern design in steel and glass.

gallery.title: File:London, Woolwich chimneys.jpg
gallery.description:
Montage of chimneys in Woolwich, South East London. Top row: Ferry Place - former Public Baths - Sunbury Street fire station - Woolwich Dockyard steam factory - former Queen Victoria Pub.
Middle row: Engineer House - former Woolwich Magistrates' Court - porter's lodge Royal Military Academy. 

Bottom row: Barnfield Estate - Verbruggen House - St Peter's RC School - Royal Arsenal Energy Centre - Woolwich Power Station (demolished).

gallery.title: File:London, Woolwich domes.jpg
gallery.description:
Montage of domes and semi-domes in Woolwich and Plumstead, South East London, UK.
Top row: Royal Arsenal Gatehouse, Royal Brass Foundry, Royal Carriage Mews, Woolwich Foot Tunnel.
2nd row: Greenwich Islamic Centre, interior Rotunda Building (Woolwich Polytechnic), Gurdwara Ramgarhia.
3rd row: former London and Provincial Bank (Jennings), Rose's or Prince Albert pub, RACS Central Stores, Ordnance Arms pub.

Bottom row: Rapier Dome (Royal Artillery Barracks), Royal Military Academy, Nash's Rotunda.

gallery.title: File:Rain cloud heading along the Thames towards Woolwich at sunset. (22987362724).jpg
gallery.artist: Alisdare Hickson from Woolwich, United Kingdom
gallery.description:
Walking along the Thames Cycle path around 4 pm on Tuesday 8 December - the blue sky suddenly turned dark as a huge rain cloud headed for Woolwich.  

In the background you can see the Thames Barrier, Canary Wharf and Docklands and on very right of the picture the Tate and Lyle sugar refinery.
